query: What criminal charges result from assaulting a family member?
reference_answer:
Domestic Violence:
Domestic violence can lead to imprisonment of up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
answer: Criminal charges for assaulting a family member can include assault charges, which typically range from misdemeanor to felony depending on the severity and circumstances of the attack. [System]
